findings.finding: Negative workload return codes from signals are ignored when perf exits zero. A real SIGSEGV workload returned -11 directly, but its scoped perf wrapper returned zero and wrote a success recording receipt.
findings.required_fix: Propagate unexpected workload signal termination; distinguish native intentional daemon shutdown; add negative regression coverage.

findings.finding: Passing reused evidence stores only result.json hash. Raw stdout/stderr have no bound checksums in the original result; latest() verifies logs only when optional logs_sha256 exists. A synthetic changed integration log was still accepted.
findings.required_fix: Bind original passing log/artifact checksums at measurement and verify them before reuse and packet creation.

findings.finding: Integration guard checks only six passing Bazel targets; it accepts skipped applicable Python test cases. Actual retained evidence has 13 passed cases and one QNX-only case skipped on Linux.
findings.required_fix: Verify applicable case-level outcomes and explicitly retain source-supported platform exclusions; reject missing-capability skips.

positive_evidence.native_repair_loop: failed check -> orchestrator -> repair -> passing check within one run
